title: Public Private Partnerships Act, 2015
provisions: Framework for preparing, procuring and implementing PPP projects; PPP Committee and PPP Unit; project agreements and risk allocation.

title: Uganda National Roads Authority (General) Regulations, 2017
status: Superseded in substance by UNRA repeal (2024) and Roads Regulations 2026
provisions: General regulations under the UNRA Act on management of national roads.

title: Uganda National Roads Authority (Vehicle Dimensions and Load Control) Regulations, 2017
status: Later replaced by Roads (Vehicle Dimensions...) Regulations 2026
provisions: Axle-load and vehicle-dimension control on national roads.

title: Uganda National Roads Authority (Ferry Management) Regulations, 2017
provisions: Management of ferries on the national road network.

title: Building Control Act, 2013 (Commencement) Instrument, 2018
provisions: Brought the Building Control Act 2013 into force (NBRB, building committees, permits, occupation permits, site safety liability).

title: National Environment Act, 2019
provisions: Environmental and social impact assessment and environmental compliance for projects.

title: Architects Registration (Continuing Professional Development) By-laws, 2019
provisions: CPD requirements for registered architects.

title: Architects Registration (Signboards and Project Licence Plates) By-laws, 2019
provisions: Signboards and project licence plates for architects' projects.

title: Public Private Partnerships Regulations, 2019
provisions: Detailed PPP procedures under the 2015 Act. (Companion: PPP (Meetings of the Committee) Regulations, SI 19 of 2019.)

title: National Building (Standards for Electrical Installations in Buildings) Code, 2019
provisions: Part of the National Building Code: design and installation standards for electrical works in buildings.
url: https://www.kcca.go.ug/media/docs/The National Building (Standards for Electrical Installations In Buildings) Code, 2019.pdf

title: National Building (Standards for Mechanical Installations in Buildings) Code, 2019
provisions: Part of the National Building Code: stairs, ramps, lifts, ventilation, fire safety, plumbing, drainage, septic tanks.

title: Roads Act, 2019
provisions: Classification and management of public roads, road reserves, road works, access roads and offences.

title: Cooperative Societies (Amendment) Act, 2020
provisions: Introduced s.55AAA and related provisions channelling SACCO/cooperative disputes to arbitration.

title: Building Control Regulations, 2020
provisions: Classification of buildings, building permits, inspections, occupation permits; applies the National Building Code 2019.

title: Building Control (Fees) Regulations, 2020
provisions: Fees for building permits and related services.

title: Building Control (Appeal Procedure) Regulations, 2021
provisions: Procedure for appeals against building committee decisions.

title: Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets (Amendment) Act, 2021
citation: Act of 2021 (number not confirmed; not on ULII)
provisions: Reformed the PPDA Act, including provisions on the Authority's functions and the PPDA Appeals Tribunal.

title: National Local Content Act, 2023
provisions: Local content obligations, including local content plans, for persons carrying out public works and extractive activities.

title: Public Procurement and Disposal of Public Assets Regulations, 2023
provisions: New PPDA regulations including: Rules and Methods for Procurement of Supplies, Works and Non-Consultancy Services (SI 100); Procurement of Consultancy Services (SI 101); Evaluation (SI 103); Contracts (SI 105); Administrative Review (SI 106); Procurement Planning (SI 99); PDEs (SI 98).

title: Law Revision (Commencement of the 7th Revised Edition) (Principal Laws) Instrument, 2024
provisions: Brought the 7th Revised Edition of the Laws into force; the Arbitration and Conciliation Act is now cited as Cap. 5 (previously Cap. 4), the Building Control Act as Cap. 136, the PPDA Act as Cap. 205.

title: Uganda Road Fund (Amendment) Act, 2024
provisions: Mainstreamed the Uganda Road Fund's functions into the Ministry responsible for roads.

title: Uganda National Roads Authority (Repeal) Act, 2024
provisions: Repealed the UNRA Act 2006, dissolved UNRA and transferred its functions to the Ministry of Works and Transport (Department of National Roads); savings provisions for staff, contracts and liabilities.

title: Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Act, 2024
provisions: Mainstreamed the functions of the Centre for Arbitration and Dispute Resolution (CADER) into the Ministry of Justice and Constitutional Affairs; repealed provisions establishing CADER as a corporate body (ss.80-82 among others).

title: East African Community Mediation Agreement Act, 2025
provisions: Domesticates the EAC mediation agreement.

title: Mortgage Refinance Institutions Act, 2026
provisions: Brings mortgage refinance institutions under Bank of Uganda regulation so they can give primary lenders longer-term funding.

title: Valuation Act, 2026
status: Assented 19 Feb 2026; in force 19 Mar 2026 (per KTA Advocates alert)
provisions: Creates the Institute of Certified Valuers to license and regulate valuers and standardise valuation practice.

title: Building Control (Amendment) Act, 2026
provisions: Amends the Building Control Act, Cap. 136. Expands enforcement powers of the National Building Review Board (incl. power to order demolition of unsafe buildings); tighter rules for multi-storey buildings; strict liability for site accidents; scaled fines for illegal construction; negligence causing injury, death or property damage punishable by up to 500 currency points and/or up to 12 years' imprisonment.

title: Judicature (Court Annexed Mediation) Rules, 2026
provisions: Accreditation and registration of court-accredited mediators, code of conduct and complaints; roles of court, mediator, parties and advocates; new appellate mediation (Part V); mediation period, virtual sessions, confidentiality and inadmissibility; adoption, enforcement and setting aside of mediated settlements; mediator remuneration and costs.

title: Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act, 2026
provisions: Section 24 deals with energy efficiency and conservation in buildings; also minimum energy performance standards, energy audits, and sustainable public procurement.

title: Employment (Amendment) Act, 2026
provisions: Reported to repeal provisions of the Labour Disputes (Arbitration and Settlement) Act that let labour officers mediate, conciliate, arbitrate and adjudicate.

title: Roads (Management of Public Roads) Regulations, 2026
provisions: Part III, execution of road works: feasibility studies and detailed engineering designs, design reports and review, execution of road works, sourcing, selection and testing of materials, non-conventional materials, registration of road engineering laboratories, labour-based technology. Also covers road reserves, fees for extracting construction materials, and access roads.

title: Roads (Vehicle Dimensions, Vehicle Load Control and Enforcement Measures) Regulations, 2026
provisions: Vehicle dimension and axle-load control and enforcement on public roads.

title: Roads (Ferry Development and Management) Regulations, 2026
provisions: Development and management of ferries forming part of the road network.

title: Atomic Energy (Control of Radioactivity in Foodstuffs, Livestock Feeds, Fertilisers and Construction Materials) Regulations, 2026
provisions: Controls radioactivity levels in construction materials, among other products.
